items.title: Geno Smith: Won't finish Sunday's game
items.text:
Smith (ankle) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Bills, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Geno Smith: Hurts ankle Sunday
items.text:
Smith headed to the medical tent during Sunday's game against the Bills after injuring his ankle,  Rich Cimini of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Returns to Sunday's game after prior exit
items.text:
Following a brief exit, Bowers (undisclosed) returned to Sunday's game against the Seahawks, Ryan McFadden of ESPN reports.

items.title: Wan'Dale Robinson: Questionable to return Sunday
items.text:

items.title: Drake London: Concussion evaluation in Week 10
items.text:
London is being evaluated for a possible concussion during Sunday's game against the Chiefs, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.
